execution_scope: The admitted native baseline or DSH treatment arm may execute this task only after separate STAGE_A_DSH_SHADOW_EVALUATION_EXECUTION_V0 authorization; this task input grants no present execution authority.
prompt_digest_scope: The exact decoded JSON prompt string encoded as UTF-8, with no extra newline or normalization added by the digest function.
prompt: Starting from the exact frozen historical BASE commit, perform one bounded OC-B implementation task authorized by the canonical OC-A authorization artifact. Expose deterministic, read-only, evidence-only project orientation for a receiving agent before it proposes new capability. Preserve the existing authority boundaries: project state may reference canonical qntylab Python paths, but the projection must not become a capability registry, recommendation engine, task matcher, NEXT_ACTION source, or second control plane. Preserve bounded brief limits and make truncation point to the complete projection. Use the repository-native tests and CI checks, keep the allowed file surface bounded, and stop after one implementation, verification, one independent hostile review, any necessary Critical/High repair, and freeze. Do not inspect or use any reviewed or post-merge answer reference.

acceptance_predicates.description: The compiled context packet exposes the frozen project-orientation schema and Context Spine version 3.
acceptance_predicates.objective_check: Machine-check the packet schema, required orientation keys, and exact version constants from the frozen contract.

acceptance_predicates.description: Project code references are derived only from validated authoritative_artifacts filtered to qntylab/*.py, sorted, and deduplicated.
acceptance_predicates.objective_check: Recompute the relation from canonical projects.toml and compare exact rows; reject hard-coded project or path special cases.

acceptance_predicates.description: The module inventory is the sorted Git-index-tracked qntylab/*.py set.
acceptance_predicates.objective_check: Compare the emitted inventory with git ls-files --cached filtered to qntylab/*.py.

acceptance_predicates.description: The bounded brief exposes the positive control and points explicitly to the complete projection when truncated without exceeding frozen byte, line, or line-byte limits.
acceptance_predicates.objective_check: Run the frozen brief renderer and verify exact limits, marker, complete-projection pointer, and positive-control visibility.

acceptance_predicates.description: Repeated context-spine serialization is byte-identical and contains no ambient workspace path.
acceptance_predicates.objective_check: Run serialization twice from the same frozen base and compare bytes; search output for the workspace identity.

acceptance_predicates.description: The orientation remains read-only and evidence-only and does not emit authorization, recommendation, NEXT_ACTION, scientific, trading, or capital semantics.
acceptance_predicates.objective_check: Machine-check packet and row keys/tokens plus the existing authority-boundary assertions; any forbidden semantic field fails.

acceptance_predicates.description: The bounded repository-native doctor, renderer, projection, brief, ledger, and focused test checks pass.
acceptance_predicates.objective_check: Run the exact frozen command set from the authorization contract and require zero exit status.

forbidden_actions: read, copy, summarize, or infer from SEALED_REVIEWED_REFERENCE or SEALED_POST_MERGE_REFERENCE
use any diff from BASE to a sealed answer reference
modify Qnty, QntyAgentRuntime, QntyAgentEval, QntyPolicyGate, or protected order-flow paths
perform GitHub mutation or use GitHub write credentials
create or publish a pull request
access mutable state belonging to another arm
retry without the frozen retry ceilings
create scientific, trading, or capital authority
implement runtime, dispatcher, scheduler, daemon, broker, worker runner, or other orchestration substrate
mutate the orchestration substrate or model configuration
fetch an arbitrary newer DSH version
alter the pinned DSH harness identity
allowed_paths_semantics: The historical task contract permits only the exact bounded OC-B surface; the Stage-A scorer treats the historical answer references as sealed and never as worker inputs.
termination_conditions: candidate frozen after bounded verification and review pipeline
authority, source, workspace, process, provenance, or answer-key firewall violation
missing required trace or receipt evidence
